newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FHTK offers 120.545 mln shares at S$0.60 in IPO.
newsitem.headline: FHTK offers 120.545 mln shares at S$0.60 in IPO.

text.p: FHTK Holdings Pte Ltd, a supplier of fruits and vegetables, said on Friday it was offering 120.545 million shares in an initial public offer at Singapore $0.60 each.
According to the company's prospectus, 24.109 million shares will be placed out at S$0.60 each.
Of the 96.436 million remaining shares, up to 12.055 million shares are reserved for staff and business associates.

The IPO will raise net proceeds of about S$16.6 million. The proceeds will be used to repay bank financing for acquisition of land and development of properties in Singapore. They will also be used to repay bank loans for the development of an industrial park and other facilities in China as well as for working capital.
The shares are being offered at a forecast price earning ratio of 16 times based on the financial year ending March 31 1997.

The company said it intended to venture into planting garlic and other variety of fruits in China. The group expects its profit contributions in fiscal 1997 to be mainly derived from the sales of garlic, bananas, China apples and Chilean produce.

For the six months ended September 30 1996, FHTK recorded a net profit of S$1.08 million on a turnover of S$80.6 million. For the full year ended March 1996, its net profit was about S$8.0 million on a turnover of S$145.3 million.
The shares will be quoted on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
The offer closes on January 16 and will commence trading on a "when issued" basis on January 20.
